text:
Ryan: Heads-up: CobaltBridge go-live tomorrow 22:00 UTC. Reserved pool -> 4xA100, quota set to 180k tpm. They said spikes to ~200k. Need quick ops sync and loadtest + fallback plan.
Mika: Copy. I'd bump quota to 220k temp for the soak? Autoscale policy is conservative; can we allow burst?
Ashley: From CS: customer requires <150ms p99 for short prompts. They want failover to hosted model if Dedicated hits capacity.
Sam: Runtime: autoscaler currently scales by GPU count with 2-min windows. For the loadtest we can lower cooldown to 45s and enable burst slotting.
Kelsey: Ops plan: shadow replay 30m then full soak 4h. I'll kick off k6 at 22:05 UTC. Cmd: `k6 run --vus 250 --duration 30m load/cobaltburst.js`
Ryan: Metrics to watch: p99 latency, queue time, GPU util, KV cache hit rate, and RPS per shard.
DeployBot: Alert scheduled: loadtest-runner will trigger at 22:05 UTC. Notifications -> #eng-runtime + #customer-success.
Mika: Also note: KMS rotation for CobaltBridge keys scheduled at 03:00 UTC; recommend postpone to 04:00 to avoid overlap.
Ashley: I'll confirm with the customer on the temp quota bump and KMS shift.
Sam: If we see sustained >85% GPU util with p99 >200ms, fallback rule: route new requests to hosted-model-v2 and mark Dedicated for manual rollback.
Kelsey: :thumbsup: Canary plan: first 15m at 30% traffic, then 60% for 15m, then full. I'll run the stages manually.
Ryan: Checklist: @Mika ops cooldown -> 45s, @Sam set fallback route, @Ashley customer sign-off. Ping here when done.
Ashley: Signed off by customer at 20:40 UTC. They approved quota 220k for a 6h window.
Mika: Done cooldown -> 45s. Autoscale policy updated: allow burst slots + pre-warm.
Sam: Fallback route in place; hosted-model-v2 ready in us-west-2.
Kelsey: Loadtest started. k6 log excerpt: "VU 250 | iterations 12500 | errors 0 so far"
Ryan: Monitoring update (10m): p99 132ms, GPU util 48%. Will update again at 60m.
Kelsey: After 1h: p99 165ms, GPU util 72%, KV cache hit 78%. No request errors.
Sam: Noticed queue spikes on shard-3. Scaling triggered +1 GPU at 22:18 UTC.
Mika: Scaling succeeded. Ops dashboard: https://console.redwood/ops/cobaltbridge/metrics (placeholder).
Ryan: Wrap summary: soak finished, no fallback triggered. Quick follow-ups: adjust default cooldown to 60s for similar workloads and consider raising default burst cap.
Kelsey: I'll file a short runbook edit with the canary timings and the k6 script path.
Ashley: I'll capture customer feedback (they were happy with latency and handover).
Sam: Leaving open action: review shard-3 distribution and improve hot-shard balancing.
Ryan: Thanks everyone — great coordination.
